correctness.rationale: The proof exhausts the three valuation cases \(p\nmid c\), \(p^2\mid c\), and \(p\parallel c\). Dirichlet supplies prime witnesses in the first case and the \(p=r\) exceptional subcase of the second. In the exact-\(p\) case multiplicativity reduces divisibility by \(4\) to the parity of \(\tau(8pn+t)\), hence to exclusion of squares; CRT gives an if-and-only-if local criterion modulo \(8\) and \(p\). The final count follows from a bijection of the \(p\) candidate \(t\)-values with residues modulo \(p\). Boundary cases \(p=r\) and \(p=3\) were separately checked in the proof. The verifier independently exhausts all parameters through \(p=199\).
